issue.title: Make Bob Mac Capture pure indentation helpers nonisolated
issue.description: Discovered by the bob-cli-t land agent while verifying the epic. macOS 26 CI runs 31890751259, 31892336680, and 31892613742 reach the Test step after format/build, then fail compiling BobMacCaptureTests because CapturePanelController.bulletIndentationEdit(direction:in:selectedRange:) is implicitly @MainActor but its pure synchronous tests are nonisolated (ActorIsolatedCall across BobMacCaptureTests.swift:897-1169). The defect was introduced before bob-cli-t by 3898739, but blocks full-suite, bundle, install, and smoke validation for both active epics bob-cli-t and bob-cli-u. Make the pure resolver and its pure helper dependency chain explicitly nonisolated where safe (leaving AppKit/model mutation main-actor isolated), retain the nonisolated tests as the contract, and verify the full macOS 26 workflow proceeds beyond Test.

payload.entry: RELATED: bob-cli-t — this pre-existing compile defect blocks the full macOS validation required before the multi-item capture epic can close.
RELATED: bob-cli-u — commit dff08a7 retains the same failing helper tests, so its active task-ID prompt epic is also blocked at the Test step.

IMPLEMENTATION: In bob-mac-capture at a1ae3fd, Sources/BobMacCapture/CapturePanelController.swift now marks only bulletIndentationEdit, its pure helper chain, and their immutable constants nonisolated; AppKit responder lookup, NSTextView mutation, completion dismissal, and CapturePanelModel calls remain main-actor isolated. Verified gh run 31892613742 failure was ActorIsolatedCall in nonisolated indentation tests; local git diff --check passed; swift build --target CaptureCore passed on Linux with existing bob-cli-w Sendable warnings. Mac app format/build/test are blocked locally by no Apple developer tools/AppKit on Linux, so bob-cli-x remains open for exact-head macOS 26 CI proof.

Verified bob-cli-x at bob-mac-capture a9ffab9 with CI run 31894453684 (https://github.com/bobs-org/bob-mac-capture/actions/runs/31894453684): macOS 26 SwiftPM job passed Show toolchain, Lint Swift formatting, Build, Test, Bundle, Verify plist and signature, Launch smoke test, and Install and reinstall; diagnostics upload was skipped only because it is conditional on launch-smoke failure.
